probe.text_sample: Your Page Title Overview Buy Hemingway Magazine Fashion Design Music Culture Travel Podcast Latest: Making records slowly About Authors Membership Contact Sign in The tailor who refuses to hurry Juliet Ramos Design and culture writer Juliet Ramos covers design and the small rooms where culture happens: studios, workshops, a cinema with thirty seats. She is interested in the decisions you can only see up close. Before Quaderno she worked in a furniture workshop in Valencia, which is where she learned to ask about joints before colours.
